title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Disconnect and Reconnect Balances, Warning Lead Time and Counseling Referral Count
content:
The PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) meter is remotely disconnected when the prepaid balance is at or below the tier's disconnect balance, and reconnected when a payment brings it to the tier's reconnect balance or more. A disconnection waits until the tier's warning lead time has passed since the most recent disconnect warning. When low-balance disconnections in 30 days reach the tier's referral count, the member is referred to an energy counseling call.

| Tier | Disconnect at or below (USD) | Reconnect at or above (USD) | Reconnect fee (USD) | Warning lead time (elapsed hours) | Disconnections in 30 days for counseling referral |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 0.00 | 10.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 4 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 0.00 | 10.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 4 |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 0.00 | 10.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 4 |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 0.00 | 20.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 4 |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 0.00 | 10.00 | 0.00 | 24 | 4 |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | -25.00 | 50.00 | 0.00 | 48 | 3 |

Notes (hypothetical balances):
- On PrePay Power Small Commercial the disconnect balance is below zero: a balance of -24.99 is above it and -25.00 is at it.
- On PrePay Power Seasonal a disconnected meter is reconnected by a payment that brings the balance to 20.00; a balance of 19.99 is short of the reconnect balance.
- The reconnect fee is 0.00 on every tier.
